authentication_failed.title: Your Claude sign-in has expired
authentication_failed.action: Sign in again in the Workspace setup tab, step Claude Code. Then reload the page.

cloud_credential_error.title: The workspace cannot sign in to Claude
cloud_credential_error.action: Sign in again in Workspace setup; if that does not help, contact your company admin.

oauth_org_not_allowed.title: This Claude account cannot be used here
oauth_org_not_allowed.action: Sign in in Workspace setup with the account your company gave you.

account_on_hold.title: The Claude account is on hold
account_on_hold.action: Contact your company admin; signing in will not fix it.

verification_required.title: Claude wants to verify your account
verification_required.action: Open claude.ai, finish the verification and try again.

billing_error.title: The Claude subscription is not active
billing_error.action: Contact your company admin; the subscription needs renewing.

rate_limit.title: You have reached your subscription limit
rate_limit.action: It resets on its own; the exact time is in the message below this text.

overloaded.title: Claude is overloaded right now
overloaded.action: This is not a problem with your workspace. Send the message again in a moment.

server_error.title: Claude is not responding
server_error.action: Try again in a moment; if it persists, contact your company admin. The cause is in the message below this text.

network.title: The workspace could not reach Claude
network.action: Try again; if it persists, contact your company admin.

model_not_found.title: The selected model is not available
model_not_found.action: Choose another model in the chat.

max_output_tokens.title: The answer was too long
max_output_tokens.action: Ask for a shorter answer or for it to be split into parts.

not_installed.title: Claude Code is missing from the workspace
not_installed.action: Contact your company admin; the workspace needs repair.
